# Pillars

> Pillars is a free Muslim prayer app for iOS and Android: accurate daily prayer (salah) times, athan notifications, Qibla, mosque jamaat times and a prayer tracker. This site hosts city prayer-time pages with today's times, a monthly timetable and nearby mosques.

Times are calculated with the adhan library using each city's standard method (UK: Moonsighting Committee, Fajr and Isha at 18°), with both Asr times (Shafi'i and Hanafi). Mosque jamaat times come from the Pillars mosque database.

## Prayer times

- [London prayer times](https://thepillarsapp.com/prayer-times/uk/london/): today's Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr (Shafi'i and Hanafi), Maghrib and Isha with an "Updated" date and the calculation method; Fajr, Maghrib (iftar) and Isha sections with the next 7 days; the month's timetable with the Hijri date on each row; calculation method; London mosques with jama'ah and Jumu'ah times; an embeddable prayer times widget; FAQ
- [United Kingdom prayer times](https://thepillarsapp.com/prayer-times/uk/): all UK cities
- [All prayer times](https://thepillarsapp.com/prayer-times/): every country and city

## App

- [Pillars on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1559086853)
- [Pillars website](https://thepillarsapp.com/)

## Embed widget

- `https://thepillarsapp.com/prayer-times/widget/?city={slug}` (for example `?city=london`): a small iframe-able page with today's six times for the city, light or dark (`&theme=light|dark`). It is marked noindex; link to the city page instead when citing times.

## In-browser tools (WebMCP)

Where WebMCP is available, each city page registers read-only tools: `get_prayer_times` (any date), `get_next_prayer`, `get_monthly_timetable` (YYYY-MM, with Hijri dates and both Asr times), `get_qibla_direction` and `get_jumuah_and_mosques` (listed mosques with jama'ah and Jumu'ah times; a `placeholder` flag marks dummy layout data). See the [prayer times skill](https://thepillarsapp.com/skills/prayer-times.md).
